counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0316 to 0.005 to improve collision resolution accuracy, eliminating wall penetration

explanation: Large dt (0.0316) with substeps insufficient to prevent wall penetration. Body penetrates wall by 0.1797 beyond 0.15 tolerance. Smaller dt fixes it, indicating integration/collision handling is unstable at large time steps.
vision_note: The red circle is perched on the top-right corner of the grey wall block in steps 9-11. At step 12 it visibly sinks and overlaps the corner/edge of the wall, showing interpenetration rather than resting on the surface.
